name: Rollback reconstruction cannot downgrade the current static spine

input.fixture_ref: Add a required static member and Contract in a later same-major revision, then request rollback to an artifact lacking them.

applicability.reason: Requires rollback reconstruction. `Reflection::Class.rollback(A)` answers UnsupportedConstruct, so no historical revision can be reconstructed for validation to refuse.

expect.status: Rollback fails validation, publishes nothing, and does not directly reactivate the historical revision or downgrade the static spine.
